name: Spreadsheets
summary: A full spreadsheet editor: sheets, 230+ functions, formatting, charts, filters, pivot tables and an AI assistant. Opens and saves Excel .xls and .xlsx, OpenDocument and CSV, encrypted under your account's own key.

screenshots.alt: The Spreadsheets editor with a menu bar, formatting toolbar, formula bar, a budget sheet with a bold blue header, a column chart and sheet tabs

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Spreadsheets
config.description: Edit spreadsheets with formulas, formatting, charts and an AI assistant; open and download Excel, OpenDocument and CSV files.

permissions.label: Read your own spreadsheets, encrypted under your account's own key
Create, change and delete your spreadsheets
Open .xls, .xlsx, .ods and .csv files you choose; they are read in your browser
Read and change the contacts of a CRM list you link, with your own CRM access
Send a request you type and part of the open sheet to the host AI model; nothing is stored
Add a Spreadsheets page to the desktop rail; the editor runs inside the desktop, signed in as your account
